description: Dataform is a framework for managing SQL based data operations in BigQuery

latest_release.name: 3.1.6-alpha.1
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* chore(publish): update scripts to use ExitGate for publish by @Ford544 in https://github.com/dataform-co/dataform/pull/2426
* chore(publish): copy bundles to workspace dir by @Ford544 in https://github.com/dataform-co/dataform/pull/2438
* docs(core): add core/README.md and bundle it in @dataform/core npm package by @rafal-hawrylak in https://github.com/dataform-co/dataform/pull/2436
* Configure Dependabot and relax exact pnpm overrides by @mbiernacik in https://github.com/dataform-co/dataform/pull/2442
* Label dependency PRs that wait for new versions in CI by @mbiernacik in https://github.com/dataform-co/dataform/pull/2443
* Prefetch fixes for security advisories and new dependencies of team PRs by @mbiernacik in https://github.com/dataform-co/dataform/pull/2441


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/dataform-co/dataform/compare/3.1.6-alpha.0...3.1.6-alpha.1
